videos.desc: A young man in a white T-shirt and jeans runs across a wide mountain meadow of tall golden grass and small wildflowers at sunset. A young woman with long brown hair, also in a white top and jeans, runs into his arms from the other side. They put their arms around each other tightly and turn round together, her hair flying out in the wind, then stand still, holding each other close. The low sun shines behind them over forested hills and distant mountains.
videos.said: I make many mistakes in life, but they bring me to you.

videos.desc: An animated woman in a green suit stands at a wooden podium with a microphone in a grand hall and gives a heartfelt speech; she gestures, toasts to the next ten years, and the seated audience smiles and applauds.
videos.said: Thank you all for coming. You changed my whole life. For the payoff, here's to the next ten years!

videos.desc: Three friends with popcorn leave the crowded rows near the stage of an open-air amphitheater and climb the stairs all the way up, then sit happily in a completely empty row at the back, far from the concert.

A 3D-animated woman on a flower-covered rooftop balcony answers her phone and has a lively, joyful call with a friend, gasping, laughing and finally promising to see them soon before hugging the phone.
videos.said: Hello, it's me! No way! Really? Me too. See you soon.

videos.desc: A man and a woman throw an orange ball back and forth on a sunny beach, each catching it in the air; the man dives into the sand to catch a long throw and they high-five and laugh.
In a hand-painted anime garden at night with paper lanterns, a girl blows out the candles on her birthday cake while two friends clap; a confetti popper goes off and the three hug and cheer.

Two animated teenagers find their seats in a dark movie theater with a bucket of popcorn. They watch a space cartoon on the big screen, gasp and laugh with wide eyes while munching popcorn in the red seats.

At an open-air concert in a park at sunset, a band plays on a small stage with bunting while a cheering crowd claps and raises their arms; a young woman with a bandana sings along, and a small dog sits on someone's shoulder.

At a night funfair, a man in a bright yellow shirt drives a red bumper car, shouts with joy as he crashes into his friends' bumper cars again and again, and finally cheers into the camera with both arms raised.
videos.said: I DRIVE THE BUMPER CAR! CRASH! I CRASH INTO MY FRIEND! SO FUN!

videos.desc: A woman cooking in a retro kitchen starts swaying and twirling her colorful skirt; her partner joins her and the two dance salsa together around the kitchen, ending with a laughing dip.
videos.said: (upbeat music) - Come on, you know you want to. - Okay, I love this.

videos.desc: A young couple stands on a bed in a sunny attic bedroom and starts a pillow fight, swinging and blocking with big white pillows. A pillow bursts, feathers explode everywhere, and they collapse laughing on the feather-covered bed, one conceding that the other wins.

In a cozy anime apartment on a rainy evening, a host in an apron opens the door to a woman who arrives with a potted flower as a gift; he takes her wet coat, leads her to a candlelit table, drapes her napkin and pours her water before they toast.
videos.said: Come in, come in! These are for you! Sit, this seat is yours. It smells amazing!

videos.desc: At airport arrivals an excited man waits with a small gift as a young woman drops her suitcase and runs to him; they crash into a huge spinning hug and hold each other tight, laughing that they missed each other.
videos.said: There she is! I missed you so much!

videos.desc: At a picnic in a poppy field, a young woman blows a kiss to her boyfriend; he playfully catches it, kisses her hand, and then gently kisses her forehead.
videos.said: Caught it forever mine Best afternoon ever

videos.desc: At sunset a group of friends holds a garden party with bunting, balloons, a snack table and lemonade; they dance on the grass with a dog running around, throw confetti and raise their cups in a toast.

At a sunny outdoor swimming pool ringed by pink flowering bushes, a woman relaxes on an orange inflatable ring while two guys cannonball off the edge one after another, sending up huge splashes and laughter. Afterwards the men float on their backs beside her in the turquoise water.

A young man in a cafe drops into a chair, puts his muddy boots up on the table next to his croissant, and stays glued to his phone while the waitress serves him; he mutters a dismissive remark instead of thanking her and later shoves past other customers on his way out.

Outside a bar at night a bearded man smokes a cigarette and taps the ash into an ashtray; nearby a woman lights an older woman's cigarette, and the smokers stand together puffing clouds under the street lights.

A woman arrives at her office desk and finds a coffee, a fresh bun and a smiley-face sticky note that someone left for her; she scans the open-plan office and questions a coworker trying to work out who it was, then gives up and happily sips the coffee holding the note.

At night a group of young men stand on a concrete ledge above a river, lighting the scene only with their phone torches. One of them takes off, tucks into a front flip and lands on a round trampoline set on the dirt below. The others lean over the ledge, sweeping their torch beams into the blackness, and two pale animal shapes appear far off on the track.

A convertible car drives at night along a resort road lined with lit palm trees and low houses. Inside, a young man drives with one hand on the wheel and a young woman in a pale yellow cardigan sits beside him; they glance at each other and smile. She reaches across and lays her hand palm up on his knee, he takes it, and they hold hands over the centre console. The last shot is a close-up of their two hands raised together with the fingers interlocked.

At night on a city pavement in front of a brick wall, a woman in a black dress and black high heels holds a bottle of champagne with both hands, laughing. She works the cork loose and the bottle erupts: a thick white jet of foam shoots several metres into the air and rains back down over the pavement. She screams, crouches down and holds the gushing bottle out in front of her at arm's length while the foam keeps fountaining up and spreads in a wide white pool across the paving stones.

A circus arena in a spotlight, with rows of the audience in silhouette. A performer in a blue costume stands on a gold pedestal and lifts a huge sheet of white cloth above their head, then opens their arms so the cloth falls into an enormous cone around them, spreading across the ring like a gown. The crowd hold up phones to film. The white cloth is then whipped away and in its place a giant peacock tail opens out in orange, white and green with a blue wheel at its centre, and the audience raise their hands and cheer.

An animated park scene with cartoon pigeons. A small grey pigeon stands beside a much larger dark blue pigeon that leans over it; the small one glares up with narrowed eyes. A white pigeon with pink feathers stands next to it, half-closing her eyes. The camera holds close on the small grey pigeon while its eyebrows lower and its face turns sour. At the end the white pigeon leans in and presses her beak to its cheek in a kiss; the grey pigeon's cheeks turn bright red and it keeps scowling while blushing.
videos.said: What's up? He was asking for directions. Cool, cool, cool, cool. Were you jealous?

videos.desc: An animated city street at sunset. A young woman with long black hair, a black leather jacket, cream trousers and a small red shoulder bag walks along the pavement, smiling and touching her hair. Ahead of her a young man in a leather jacket leans against a black car holding a huge bouquet of pink and cream peonies. She sees him, stops, and covers her mouth with her hand, eyes wide. He steps forward and holds the flowers out to her; she buries her face in the bouquet, then they stand close together behind the flowers, smiling at each other in the golden light.

A white-haired woman in a blue blouse sits at a table behind a large white cake with blue piping and three silver candles shaped as a 1, a 0 and a 0. Hands hang a colourful HAPPY BIRTHDAY banner on the black wall behind her and balloons show at the edges of the frame. Wearing a small tiara and a pair of pixel sunglasses, she blows the candles out one after another and then laughs at the camera.

In an empty car park at sunset an old woman in a bright pink cardigan sits on a red mobility scooter. Someone in front of her holds out a round turquoise cake covered in rainbow sprinkles on a white board and presses silver 1, 0 and 0 candles into the icing. She drives the scooter after the cake, laughing, and reaches out both hands for the plate as it is held towards her.

A cafe table by a window. A man in a camel coat and a woman in a black polo neck both freeze open-mouthed as spilled drink spreads across the wooden table and soaks the open sketchbook in front of her. He leans in talking fast, pulls napkins from the holder and blots the wet page, then lifts the book clear. He comes back with a cup of coffee, sets it down in front of her and speaks with his hands open; she turns to him and smiles.

A man sits at a small street bar as a bottle of beer is slid to him across the wooden counter. Inside, under coloured lights, a barman shakes a metal shaker and strains an orange drink into a wide glass in front of him. The clip ends on a rooftop at dusk where a group of friends have come together along a long marble counter under strings of bulbs and all reach in to clink their glasses.

An older man in a flat cap sits on a wooden bench in a park, opens a paper bag of grain and scatters it on the path, and pigeons crowd around his feet. The shot moves to a seafront promenade with palm trees, where he sits on a metal bench by the blue sea with the bag still in his hand, and then he is sitting shoulder to shoulder with two other older men on the bench, all of them talking and laughing together.

A woman in a green dress sits at a long wooden dining table that has already been laid with plates and cutlery. She strikes a match and holds it to the wick of a tall cream candle in a grey holder until it catches. She then works her way down the table lighting one candle after another with the match. In the last shots the room is dark, the whole row of candles is burning down the middle of the laid table, and she sits at the end of it looking down the table and smiling, waiting for her guests.

A birthday party in a small flat decorated with paper chains, fairy lights and balloons. A woman in a pink dress and a silver party hat stands in the doorway while friends hold a white and black drip cake in front of her and light the row of candles. She closes her eyes for a second, then leans forward and blows the candles out; smoke rises from the cake, everyone throws up their arms and cheers, and her friends crowd in to hug her around the table.

A run of street-dance scenes. A breakdancer flips upside down on a sunny city plaza inside a ring of people who clap and film him. Then women in wide rainbow-coloured folk skirts spin in the middle of a street while onlookers press in on both sides. Next about ten dancers move as one down the aisle of a shopping centre, with shoppers gathering along the sides. Finally the camera lifts to show hundreds of people filling a whole city square at dusk, all dancing the same steps in rows that run back to the buildings.

A room is being decorated for a party. Two hands press a paper chain against a white wall, running through red, orange, yellow, green and blue links. Pale pink and deep blue balloons are stuck to the wall above a grey sofa. The rainbow chain is then strung in a curve above a row of grey triangular bunting. In the evening the room is lit up: a man on a stepladder hangs bright garlands under a canopy of fairy lights while a woman holds a pink balloon, and the whole floor disappears under hundreds of pink, blue, orange, yellow and silver balloons.

A young man in a black jacket stands in a hallway looking at his phone with a pained face as he apologises. In the kitchen behind him another young man in a stained apron is serving a hot pan of stew onto a table laid for three, under a paper banner reading 'Congratulations'. The friend leaves through the door; the cook is left standing alone at the table, then sits down by himself in front of the untouched dish and the single candle.
videos.said: I'm so sorry. Work. Right. Sorry.

videos.desc: A young man puts his mouth close to a window furred with white frost and breathes hard on the glass until a clear round hole opens in it and his face shows through. He is then at a party with friends around him, leaning over a birthday cake covered in lit candles; he purses his lips, breathes out hard and the flames go out. Next he leans over a row of coloured paper party blowers on a white table and puffs them so they uncoil and shoot out one after another. Finally a long table crowded with dozens of candles and a room full of friends all lean in and puff together, then cheer with their arms up under the streamers and fairy lights.

A plain office with a venetian blind. A man and a woman sit side by side at a wooden table, each with their own printed document and pen in front of them, and each signs their own sheet. They then twist the wedding rings off their fingers and set the two rings down on the bare table between the papers. Both stand, turn away from each other, and walk out of the room through two different grey doors, leaving the two documents, the two pens and the two rings behind on the table.

A young woman with curly hair carries a small chocolate cake with one lit candle up behind a young man sitting indoors; he turns and his mouth falls open. The scene cuts to an outdoor basketball court at sunset where he dribbles a ball with the low sun behind him, then to the same woman standing under the hoop holding up a handmade sign with a red heart on it and cheering. In the last shots the two of them stand face to face with white cake frosting smeared over their cheeks and chins, laughing, then lean into the camera together with a lit dome and Paris rooftops behind them.

A large family party in a house hung with cut-paper bunting. A man holds out a wrapped present with a purple bow to a very old woman, who takes it with both hands while relatives watch and smile. She is then handed an open tin of chocolate-chip cookies by a middle-aged woman in a floral shirt. A young woman opens a photo album and gasps at a picture inside while an older man looks over her shoulder. In the final shots the whole family crowds around a table loaded with food and passes small wrapped boxes from hand to hand across it.

Two young women meet face to face in a club with purple and pink neon lights behind them. They are wearing exactly the same patterned mini dress, and they stare at each other's dress with their mouths open. The blonde one shouts angrily at the other, then her face breaks into a smile as they talk it over; the dark haired one starts to cry and laugh at once, and the two of them fall into a long hug in their matching dresses.
videos.said: Stress. Tim is coming today. Tim? Really? Then I'll go home and change. This is the strongest friendship.
